verdict.rationale: Automating tasks with a built-in scripting tool is a fair question for a desktop OS, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack never documents an automation or scripting tool for repetitive tasks. Related items such as a command-line tutorial, starting an application at login, changing the default terminal and AT-SPI DBus interfaces are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not an automation capability. missing for 10: any documented built-in automation or scripting tool, evidence of automating repetitive tasks, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can automate repetitive tasks using a built-in automation/scripting tool
